prompt: Make a 3D CAD model of a rectangular block 40 mm long (X), 30 mm wide (Y) and 20 mm high (Z).
Make a 3D CAD model of a solid cylinder of radius 15 mm and height 50 mm, standing on the XY plane.

Make a 3D CAD model of a solid vase by revolving a profile 360 degrees about the Z axis. In the (radius, height) plane the closed profile is: start on the axis at (0, 0), go out to (20, 0), straight line to (25, 30), then a circular arc through (23, 46) ending at (15, 60), straight line to (18, 80), then straight back to the axis at (0, 80) and down the axis to the start. All values in mm.
3D CAD model: Draw a 50 mm (X) by 20 mm (Z) rectangle centred on the origin in the XZ plane and extrude it symmetrically 15 mm to each side along Y (30 mm total).

Make a 3D CAD model of a box 40 x 40 x 20 mm with one corner at the origin (x 0..40, y 0..40, z 0..20). Add a cylinder of radius 12 mm, 40 mm tall, standing on z = 0 with its axis at (x 40, y 20), and join the two into one solid.

Make a 3D CAD model of a box 50 x 50 mm in plan and 20 mm deep, centred on the origin in X and Y, occupying z = -20 to 0. Subtract a sphere of radius 15 mm centred at the origin, leaving a hemispherical dimple in the top face.
Make a 3D CAD model of the intersection of a 40 mm cube centred on the origin and a sphere of radius 25 mm centred on the origin.
3D CAD model: Loft a solid from a 40 x 40 mm square centred on the origin in the XY plane (z = 0) to a circle of diameter 20 mm centred on the Z axis at z = 40.

Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 60 x 40 x 15 mm (x 0..60, y 0..40, z 0..15). Drill three holes from the top face, all on the line y = 20: at x = 15 a through counterbored hole, diameter 8 mm with a counterbore 14 mm diameter and 5 mm deep; at x = 35 a through countersunk hole, diameter 6 mm with a 90 degree countersink of 12 mm top diameter; at x = 50 a blind hole of diameter 6 mm, 10 mm deep to the end of the cylindrical part, with a 118 degree drill point at the bottom.

Make a 3D CAD model of an L-shaped bar: the profile in the XY plane is the polygon (0,0), (60,0), (60,8), (8,8), (8,40), (0,40) (two legs 8 mm thick, 60 and 40 mm long overall), extruded 20 mm along Z.
Make a 3D CAD model of an obround (slot-shaped) plate 5 mm thick: two semicircular ends of radius 6 mm whose centres are 40 mm apart, joined by straight tangent sides (overall 52 x 12 mm).

Make a 3D CAD model of a 40 x 40 mm square block 30 mm high centred on the Z axis, standing on z = 0, and give its four side faces a 5 degree draft hinged at the bottom face so the block gets wider towards the top (the bottom stays 40 x 40 mm).

Make a 3D CAD model of a cylinder of radius 20 mm along the Z axis from z = -30 to z = +30, then split it into two separate solids with the plane that contains the X axis and is tilted 30 degrees from the XY plane. Keep both pieces (two bodies).

Make a 3D CAD model of an angle bracket. Base plate 80 (X) x 50 (Y) x 8 mm thick (x 0..80, y 0..50, z 0..8). A back wall 8 mm thick on the back edge (y 42..50) rising from the base top to z = 50, full 80 mm width. Round the inside corner between the base top and the wall front face with a 5 mm fillet. Add a triangular gusset 6 mm thick centred at x = 40 (x 37..43) whose triangle in the YZ plane has corners (y 42, z 8), (y 42, z 35) and (y 15, z 8). Cut two 8 mm diameter vertical through holes in the base at (x 20, y 20) and (x 60, y 20). Cut two 10 mm diameter holes horizontally through the wall at x = 20 and x = 60, both at height z = 30. Finally chamfer the two vertical edges at the front corners of the base (y = 0) by 3 mm.
Make a 3D CAD model of a block 60 mm wide (X), 40 mm deep (Y) and 15 mm high (Z) with one corner at the origin, with a vertical through hole of diameter 10 mm in the centre of the top face.

Make a 3D CAD model of a triangular plate 5 mm thick. The triangle has corners at (0, 0) and (50, 0); the third corner P makes a 60 degree angle at the origin (between the base and the side from the origin to P), and the side from (50, 0) to P is 45 mm long. Of the two possible positions of P take the one farther from the origin.

Make a 3D CAD model of a flat link 5 mm thick whose outline is a circle of diameter 40 mm at the origin and a circle of diameter 20 mm centred at (50, 0), joined by the two straight lines tangent to both circles (the convex outline around both circles). Cut a through hole of diameter 8 mm concentric with the small circle.

Make a 3D CAD model of a block 80 x 60 x 20 mm (x 0..80, y 0..60, z 0..20). Cut a rectangular pocket 50 x 30 mm (x 15..65, y 15..45) 8 mm deep from the top face. Round the 4 vertical corner edges of the pocket with 5 mm fillets, then round all edges of the pocket floor with 2 mm fillets.

Make a 3D CAD model of a block 40 mm in X (x -20..20), 35 mm in Y (y -25..10) and 20 mm high (z 0..20). Then cut a groove by revolving an 8 x 8 mm square (radius 4 to 12 mm from the Z axis, z 12 to 20) 270 degrees about the Z axis, starting at the +X direction and turning towards +Y (counter-clockwise seen from above), so the quarter between -Y and +X is left uncut.

Make a 3D CAD model of an open-top box: a 60 x 40 x 30 mm block (x 0..60, y 0..40, z 0..30) shelled inwards to a 3 mm wall with the top face removed. Then round the 4 outer vertical edges with 6 mm fillets, the 4 inner vertical edges with 3 mm fillets, and finally the whole edge loop around the inner floor (z = 3) with 1 mm fillets.
Make a 3D CAD model of an L-shaped bar with profile (0,0), (60,0), (60,8), (8,8), (8,40), (0,40) in the XY plane, extruded 20 mm along Z, then round every edge of the solid with a 2 mm fillet.

Make a 3D CAD model of a square plate 60 x 60 x 8 mm centred on the origin in X and Y (z 0..8) with a cylindrical boss of diameter 20 mm and 15 mm tall on its top centre (z 8..23). Fillet the joint where the boss meets the plate with a 3 mm radius and round the top edge of the boss with a 2 mm radius.

Make a 3D CAD model of an obround plate 10 mm thick: semicircular ends of radius 8 mm with centres 40 mm apart, joined by straight tangent sides. Round the whole top edge loop with a 2 mm fillet and chamfer the whole bottom edge loop by 1 mm.
Make a 3D CAD model of a block 40 x 30 x 20 mm (Z up). Chamfer its 4 vertical edges by 5 mm, then round all 8 edges of the (now octagonal) top face with 2 mm fillets.

Make a 3D CAD model of a solid cylinder of radius 15 mm lying along the X axis from x = -40 to x = 40, and join a solid cylinder of radius 10 mm along the Z axis from z = 0 to z = 35 (a solid tee). Round the saddle-shaped intersection edge between the two cylinders with a 3 mm fillet.
Make a 3D CAD model of a block 50 x 40 x 30 mm (Z up). Round its 4 vertical edges with 8 mm fillets, then round the whole edge loop of the top face with 4 mm fillets.

Make a 3D CAD model of a square pyramid: base 40 x 40 mm centred on the origin at z = 0, apex at (0, 0, 30). Round all 8 edges (4 base edges and 4 sloping edges, which meet at the apex) with 2 mm fillets.
Make a 3D CAD model of one solid from two cylinders of radius 10 mm on the Z axis: one from z = 0 to 30, the other from z = 20 to 50 (they overlap), joined together.

Make a 3D CAD model of a pipe tee. Main pipe along the X axis from x = -40 to 40, outside diameter 30 mm, inside diameter 24 mm. Branch pipe along +Z from the main pipe axis (z = 0) up to z = 40, outside diameter 20 mm, inside diameter 14 mm. Join the outsides first, then cut both bores so the branch bore opens into the main bore.

Make a 3D CAD model of a box 60 x 60 mm in plan and 10 mm thick, centred on the origin in X and Y, occupying z = -10 to 0. Join a sphere of radius 12 mm centred at the origin (it forms a dome on top and pokes out 2 mm below the bottom). Then cut a torus centred at the origin with its axis along Z, major radius 22 mm and tube radius 4 mm, which leaves a half-round ring groove in the top face.

Make a 3D CAD model of a tube along Z, outside diameter 40 mm, inside diameter 34 mm, 60 mm long (z 0..60). Drill 4 mm diameter radial holes through both walls along the Y direction at heights z = 15, 30 and 45. Then repeat those holes rotated 60 and 120 degrees about the tube axis, giving 18 wall openings in total.

Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 100 x 100 x 5 mm centred on the origin in X and Y (z 0..5). Cut 10 mm diameter through holes in a 5 x 5 grid with 15 mm pitch in X and Y, the first hole at (-30, -30) (so x and y run -30, -15, 0, 15, 30). Also cut eight 10 mm diameter through holes equally spaced on a circle of radius 25 mm about the origin, the first at (25, 0). Where holes overlap they merge.

Make a 3D CAD model of an L-shaped bar with profile (0,0), (60,0), (60,8), (8,8), (8,40), (0,40) in the XY plane, extruded 20 mm along Z, then shell it inwards to a 2 mm wall thickness with the top face (z = 20) removed (open at the top).

Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 60 x 60 x 10 mm centred on the origin in X and Y (z 0..10) with a cylindrical boss of diameter 24 mm and 20 mm tall on its top centre (z 10..30). Shell the part inwards to a 2 mm wall with the bottom face removed (hollow from below).

Make a 3D CAD model of a block 80 x 60 x 25 mm (x 0..80, y 0..60, z 0..25). Cut an obround pocket 10 mm deep from the top face: semicircular ends of radius 10 mm centred at (25, 30) and (55, 30) joined by tangent straight sides. Give all pocket walls a 5 degree draft with the top face as the neutral plane, so the pocket keeps its outline at the top and gets narrower towards its floor.

Make a 3D CAD model of a coil spring: sweep a circle of diameter 4 mm along a helix around the Z axis of radius 20 mm, pitch 8 mm and 3 turns, starting at (20, 0, 0) and rising to z = 24. The circle sits in the plane through the axis (the XZ plane) at the start.

Make a 3D CAD model of a bent rod of diameter 10 mm by sweeping a circle along this path: from the origin straight up the Z axis 20 mm, then a 90 degree bend of 5 mm centreline radius turning towards +X, then straight 20 mm along +X (the path ends at (25, 0, 25)).
3D CAD model: Loft a solid from a 60 x 30 mm rectangle centred on the origin in the XY plane (z = 0) to a circle of diameter 30 mm centred at (10, 5) on the plane z = 50.

Make a 3D CAD model of a disc of radius 40 mm and 8 mm thick (z 0..8). On its top add six cylindrical bosses of diameter 12 mm and 10 mm tall, equally spaced on a 28 mm radius circle (the first at (28, 0)). Fillet the base of each boss where it meets the disc with a 2 mm radius.

Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 120 x 60 x 5 mm (x 0..120, y 0..60, z 0..5). Cut seven 6 mm diameter through holes whose centres are spaced equally along the circular arc that passes through (100, 15), (60, 45) and (20, 15): the first hole at (100, 15), the last at (20, 15).

Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 40 x 30 x 15 mm (x 0..40, y 0..30, z 0..15) with an M8x1.25 tapped blind hole at (20, 15) from the top: model only the 6.8 mm tap-drill hole, 12 mm deep to the end of the cylinder, with a 118 degree drill point (the thread itself is cosmetic and is not modelled).

Make a 3D CAD model of a solid cylinder of radius 25 mm along Z, 40 mm tall (z 0..40). Drill two radial blind holes of diameter 6 mm towards the axis, one at (25, 0, 20) and one at (0, 25, 20) on the curved face, each 10 mm deep measured from that surface point to the end of the cylindrical part, with a 118 degree drill point.

Make a 3D CAD model of a phone stand. Its side profile in the XZ plane (x, z) is the closed polygon (0, 0), (90, 0), (90, 18), (84, 18), (84, 6), (30, 6), (-8.0356, 87.5677), (-14.0356, 87.5677), (24, 6), (0, 6): a 6 mm thick base 90 mm long with a front lip 18 mm high, and a 6 mm wide back rest leaning back at 65 degrees. Extrude it symmetrically 35 mm to each side along Y (70 mm wide). Fillet the two inside corners where the back rest meets the base (the edges at x = 30, z = 6 and at x = 24, z = 6) with 3 mm radius, and the inside corner at the lip root (x = 84, z = 6) with 2 mm radius. Finally cut a rectangular cable slot vertically through the base, x 45..70 and y -10..10.

Make a 3D CAD model of an electronics enclosure base. Start from a block 100 x 60 x 30 mm (x 0..100, y 0..60, z 0..30), round its 4 vertical edges with 6 mm fillets, then shell it inwards to a 2 mm wall with the top face open (inner floor at z = 2). Inside, add four cylindrical screw bosses of diameter 8 mm standing on the floor and reaching z = 26, centred at (8, 8), (92, 8), (8, 52) and (92, 52), and a 2 mm thick rib along Y (x 49..51, y 2..58) from the floor up to z = 12. Drill a 3 mm diameter hole 20 mm deep into the top of each boss.

Make a 3D CAD model of a weld-neck pipe flange by revolving about the Z axis this (radius, z) profile: (25, 0), (75, 0), (75, 16), (40, 16), (37, 50), (25, 50) - a bore of 50 mm diameter, a flange disc 150 mm diameter and 16 mm thick, and a neck tapering from 80 mm diameter at the disc to 74 mm diameter at z = 50. Cut eight 14 mm diameter bolt holes through the disc, equally spaced on a 120 mm diameter pitch circle (first one at (60, 0)). Chamfer the bore edge at the top of the neck by 2 mm and fillet the corner where the neck meets the disc with a 4 mm radius.

Make a 3D CAD model of a stepped shaft along the Z axis: diameter 20 mm from z = 0 to 30, diameter 25 mm from z = 30 to 90, and diameter 20 mm from z = 90 to 120. Chamfer both end edges by 1 mm. Cut a key slot into the 25 mm section on the +X side, 4 mm deep measured from the plane x = 12.5 tangent to the shaft (flat floor at x = 8.5). Seen from +X its outline is the 8 x 30 mm rectangle y -4..4, z 45..75 with a half-circle bite of radius 4 mm removed from each short end (centred at (y 0, z 45) and (y 0, z 75)), so both slot ends are concave: the slot is 30 mm long at its sides and only 22 mm long on its centre line.

Make a 3D CAD model of a hinge leaf: a plate 40 x 30 x 3 mm (x 0..40, y 0..30, z 0..3). Along its back edge add a knuckle: a solid cylinder of radius 4 mm along X from x = 0 to 40 with its axis at y = 33, z = 4. Bore a 4 mm diameter pin hole along that axis through the whole length. Then cut a gap for the mating leaf: remove everything in x 12..28, y 29..40 through the full height.

Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 3 mm thick whose outline is: straight bottom edge from (0, -20) to (80, -20), vertical sides at x = 0 and x = 80 up to y = 0, and a wavy top made of four circular arcs of radius 12 mm, each spanning a 20 mm chord along y = 0 (x 0-20, 20-40, 40-60, 60-80), alternately bulging up (+Y) and down (-Y) starting with up, each arc tangent to the next.

Make a 3D CAD model of a flat linkage arm 6 mm thick. Outline: a 12 mm radius round end centred at the origin and an 8 mm radius round end centred at (60, 0), joined by the two straight lines tangent to both ends. Cut a 12 mm diameter hole concentric with the big end, an 8 mm diameter hole concentric with the small end, and two 4 mm diameter holes at (30, 4) and (30, -4).
Make a 3D CAD model of a flat steel sheet blank 100 x 60 mm and 2.5 mm thick.

Make a 3D CAD model of a sheet-metal L bracket from 3 mm steel, 100 mm wide along X. The base lies flat on z = 0 and is 60 mm deep in Y measured to the outside of the bend; along its y = 0 edge the sheet is bent up 90 degrees with an inside bend radius of 3 mm, and the upright flange is 20 mm high measured to the outside (top at z = 20, outer face at y = 0).

Make a 3D CAD model of a block 40 x 30 x 20 mm (x 0..40, y 0..30, z 0..20) and round its top front edge (the edge along X at y = 0, z = 20) with a constant-radius fillet whose chord length (the straight distance across the round, from where it leaves the top face to where it leaves the front face) is 4 mm.

Make a 3D CAD model of a flat plate 2 mm thick, centred on the XY plane (z -1 to +1), whose outline is a 10 x 10 mm square (x 0..10, y 0..10) with a half circle of radius 5 mm added on its top side (centred at (5, 10), bulging to y = 15).
Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 100 x 80 x 20 mm (x 0..100, y 0..80, z 0..20) with two 10 mm diameter vertical through bores at (20, 20) and (60, 50).
Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 100 x 100 x 20 mm (x 0..100, y 0..100, z 0..20) with two 10 mm diameter vertical through bores at (20, 20) and (60, 50).
Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 100 x 80 x 20 mm (x 0..100, y 0..80, z 0..20) with a 12 mm diameter vertical through bore at (20, 20) and a 10 mm diameter vertical through bore at (60, 50).
Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 100 x 80 x 20 mm (x 0..100, y 0..80, z 0..20) with a single 10 mm diameter vertical through bore at (60, 50).

Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 100 x 80 x 20 mm (x 0..100, y 0..80, z 0..20) with two 10 mm diameter vertical through bores at (20, 20) and (60, 50), and round its four vertical outside corner edges with 10 mm radius.

Make a 3D CAD model of a plate 100 x 80 x 20 mm (x 0..100, y 0..80, z 0..20) with two 10 mm diameter vertical through bores at (20, 20) and (60, 50). Round its four vertical outside corner edges with 10 mm radius, then chamfer the whole outer top perimeter (the rounded rectangle edge loop of the top face, not the bores) by 2 mm.
